label: letterbox=False
hypothesis: Off means a squashing resize instead of aspect-preserving padding. Worth about 0.03 recall on this fisheye footage - so this row is what that 0.03 looks like.

label: per_image_standardise=True
hypothesis: Z-score the frame, removing the global brightness offset that separates a daylight morning from a floodlit night - i.e. it attacks the day/night confound head-on.

label: top_crop=0.35
